categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Anjubao Digital Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the security and smart home industry, focusing on the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of building intercom systems, smart home systems, security alarm systems, parking systems, and monitoring systems. The company also engages in smart community solutions and parking lot advertising services. Its products mainly serve residential communities and commercial buildings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes TCP/IP network communication, audio-video processing, cloud communication, and biometric technologies such as facial recognition, fingerprint, and voice recognition in its products. It integrates AI, IoT, cloud computing, and big data technologies to develop intelligent, platform-based management systems. Manufacturing follows an 'order plus inventory' model, with procurement focused on cost control and competitive sourcing of electronic components like display modules, IC chips, and structural parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include system integrators, engineering contractors, and large real estate developers, primarily serving new residential housing projects across China. The company’s products are widely used in residential communities, villas, hospitals, banks, schools, and commercial complexes. The parking system and advertising business targets property management, commercial plazas, office buildings, transportation hubs, government agencies, schools, hospitals, and scenic areas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with sales and marketing networks established in numerous cities nationwide. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and Macau, using local currencies for business convenience. The company is expanding its presence in domestic markets and exploring international markets for smart home products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anjubao operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the security and smart home supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing, and direct sales to system integrators and real estate developers. It also provides integrated solutions and after-sales services, positioning itself as a key technology provider and system integrator within the smart community ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in AI integration, cloud intercom systems, biometric recognition, and smart community platform development. It actively incorporates AI large models (e.g., DeepSeek) for enhanced user experience and intelligent control. R&D efforts focus on product innovation in building intercoms, smart home central control screens, and smart parking solutions, with significant investment in upgrading existing products and developing new intelligent hardware and software platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of building intercom systems, smart home systems, parking systems, monitoring systems, and related hardware. The company also earns income from parking lot advertising services and system integration projects. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales channels supported by a nationwide marketing and service network.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anjubao is a leading brand in China's community security industry, recognized as a vice-chair unit of the China Security Association and a key contributor to national standards. It holds over 200 patents and software copyrights and has received multiple industry awards. The company faces competition from other domestic security and smart home manufacturers as well as internet giants entering the smart home market, but maintains a strong market position with approximately 7.4% market share in building intercom shipments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 206.8 million, a 42.7% decline from the previous year, primarily due to the downturn in the real estate sector. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 51.76 million, reflecting ongoing losses. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.43 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.26 billion. Despite revenue decline, the company maintains a strong cash position with RMB 276 million in cash and RMB 511 million in liquid financial assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anjubao emphasizes integrated AI-driven smart community solutions combining building intercom, smart home, parking, and security systems into unified platforms. Its products feature advanced biometric recognition, cloud intercom capabilities, and AI large model integration for personalized and intelligent user experiences. The company’s extensive patent portfolio, industry standard leadership, and comprehensive after-sales service network differentiate it from competitors, offering customers high-quality, innovative, and reliable smart security and home automation solutions.
